explanation: Added the `new` keyword when instantiating the Stripe client to comply with v22.0.0 where Stripe is a true ES6 class.
Updated stripe.customers.retrieve to pass the apiKey inside the RequestOptions object instead of as a plain string argument.
Converted the function to use async/await since callback support was removed in v22.0.0.
Renamed stripe.parseThinEvent to stripe.parseEventNotification as per the v19.0.0 SDK breaking change.
Updated Stripe.webhooks() to Stripe.webhooks to match the v18.0.0 breaking change where it became a plain object.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold on Billing.AlertCreateParams to match SDK v17.0.0.
Renamed volume_decimal to quantity_decimal in the fuel purchase details parameters to match the v16.0.0 SDK breaking change.
Renamed the `listUpcomingLineItems` method to `listUpcomingLines` on the `Invoice` resource as specified in the v10.0.0 breaking change.
Added a TODO comment because retrieveDetails was removed with no direct SDK replacement.
Updated the SDK call from stripe.checkoutSessions.create to stripe.checkout.sessions.create to reflect the rename and namespacing in v6.21.0.
Added a TODO comment above the removed expires_after field as it had no replacement in the SDK update.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold on Billing.Alert to match SDK v17.0.0.
Added optional chaining to guard the read of the now-optional transition field in the trial offer end behavior.
